text: It's a bitty spider, smashin', smashin'.

text: 让我们玩全球热核战争吧。
source_text: 让我们玩全球热核战争吧。

text: Oooh, pretty, pretty stuff.  Why is the moon?
source_text: Oooh, pretty, pretty stuff.  Why is the moon?

text: 哦哦哦，漂亮，漂亮东西。为什么是月亮？
source_text: 哦哦哦，漂亮，漂亮东西。为什么是月亮？

text: Uh, I talked with Harold.  The Deathclaw sounds pretty nasty.  What can you tell me about it?
source_text: Uh, I talked with Harold.  The Deathclaw sounds pretty nasty.  What can you tell me about it?

text: 呃，我和哈罗德谈了。死亡爪听起来相当骇人。关于它你能告诉我什么？
source_text: 呃，我和哈罗德谈了。死亡爪听起来相当骇人。关于它你能告诉我什么？

text: Beth told me to talk to you about the Deathclaw.
source_text: Beth told me to talk to you about the Deathclaw.

text: 贝斯让我和你谈谈死亡爪的事。
source_text: 贝斯让我和你谈谈死亡爪的事。

text: What do you do around here?
source_text: What do you do around here?

text: All bright, it's all bright, the bright comes down, and then we are doomed.
source_text: All bright, it's all bright, the bright comes down, and then we are doomed.

text: 全是亮的，所有的都是亮的，这亮光降到地面，我们就死了。
source_text: 全是亮的，所有的都是亮的，这亮光降到地面，我们就死了。

text: 死亡爪，死亡爪，死死死亡爪。
source_text: 死亡爪，死亡爪，死死死亡爪。

text: Come on, what do you know about the Deathclaw?
source_text: Come on, what do you know about the Deathclaw?

text: 告诉我，你知道哪些关于死亡爪的事情？
source_text: 告诉我，你知道哪些关于死亡爪的事情？

text: Don't make me pound it out of you!
source_text: Don't make me pound it out of you!

text: 快说，别让我把你敲个稀碎！
source_text: 快说，别让我把你敲个稀碎！

text: Do, I, do, then you do, then we all do.
source_text: Do, I, do, then you do, then we all do.

text: 做，我，做，然后你做，然后我们都做。
source_text: 做，我，做，然后你做，然后我们都做。

text: No really, what do you do.
source_text: No really, what do you do.

text: Problems are like Soup Bowls, wide and shallow.
source_text: Problems are like Soup Bowls, wide and shallow.

text: Deathclaw scary, really scary.  Looks neat though.  Wanna' see it?
source_text: Deathclaw scary, really scary.  Looks neat though.  Wanna' see it?

text: 死亡爪吓人，真的很吓人。尽管看起来很干净。想看看它吗？
source_text: 死亡爪吓人，真的很吓人。尽管看起来很干净。想看看它吗？

text: You can take me to the Deathclaw?
source_text: You can take me to the Deathclaw?

text: Yeah, Deathclaw, Deathclaw, going to see the Deathclaw.
source_text: Yeah, Deathclaw, Deathclaw, going to see the Deathclaw.

text: 耶，死亡爪，死亡爪，我们去见死亡爪。
source_text: 耶，死亡爪，死亡爪，我们去见死亡爪。

text: Just shut up and take me there.
source_text: Just shut up and take me there.

text: Ah, nevermind.  You take care, now.
source_text: Ah, nevermind.  You take care, now.

text: 啊，别在意。你现在要当心了。
source_text: 啊，别在意。你现在要当心了。

text: I do this, then I do that.  You see Harold?  Harold's fun, his hair falls out, falls in the wind.  There it goes... wind, wind.
source_text: I do this, then I do that.  You see Harold?  Harold's fun, his hair falls out, falls in the wind.  There it goes... wind, wind.

text: 我做这个，然后我做那个。你看见哈罗德了？哈罗德很滑稽，他的头发掉光了，随风而去了。飞了……风，风。
source_text: 我做这个，然后我做那个。你看见哈罗德了？哈罗德很滑稽，他的头发掉光了，随风而去了。飞了……风，风。

text: Pound and Pound, and Pound and Pound.
source_text: Pound and Pound, and Pound and Pound.

text: Why is the wind?  Why why why why why.
source_text: Why is the wind?  Why why why why why.

text: 为什么是风？为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么。
source_text: 为什么是风？为什么为什么为什么为什么为什么。

text: Beth, Beth, shoo sha Beth.  Like Harold, you talk Harold.  Harold tell you story.  Slappy help then.
source_text: Beth, Beth, shoo sha Beth.  Like Harold, you talk Harold.  Harold tell you story.  Slappy help then.

text: 贝斯，贝斯，嘘嗄贝斯。喜欢哈罗德，你跟哈罗德唠。哈罗德给你讲故事。斯莱匹帮忙。
source_text: 贝斯，贝斯，嘘嗄贝斯。喜欢哈罗德，你跟哈罗德唠。哈罗德给你讲故事。斯莱匹帮忙。

text: OK, I'll go talk to Harold first.
source_text: OK, I'll go talk to Harold first.

text: 好，我先去和哈罗德谈谈。
